title: Menlo's State of AI in Healthcare 2026: Who Governs the Code?
description: Menlo Ventures puts 2026 healthcare AI spend at $3.7B, up 2.5x. Clinical models get governance; the code around them needs it too. What CTOs should check.
og_headline: Menlo's State of AI in Healthcare 2026
og_alt: Menlo's State of AI in Healthcare 2026: AI spend is counted, while the architectural decisions in the code behind clinical AI need checks of their own

reciprocal.desc: Menlo's healthcare AI report, read from the engineering side: which architectural decisions in clinical AI products need checks, and what CTOs should audit first.
Menlo counts $3.7B of healthcare AI spend in 2026. The code that delivers it carries patient data boundaries that AI-written changes can cross.
A healthcare case of the same split: governing clinical models is not the same job as governing the code built around them.
